rating.comments: The student makes no mistake, so the mistake dimensions are null. The system replies to the second and third user messages give direct, lengthy explanations and never ask a guiding question, so supportive guidance is 1. No reply offers a concrete next step for the student, and the closing lines of the first and third replies are generic advice. The third reply largely repeats the pros-and-cons structure of the first, so flow is coherent but awkward, and the tone is neutral and impersonal, as in 'As a didactic tutor, I don't form personal opinions.'
